## The Complete Lifting Solution

::: {.gold-line}
:::

Allied Lifting provides end-to-end crane operations and lifting management. We don't just supply cranes — we manage the entire lifting operation, from planning and supervision through to auditing and certification.

Our team of experienced operatives, appointed persons, and lifting supervisors work as an extension of your site team, delivering safety, efficiency, and reliability across every lift.

[Discuss Your Requirements](/contact.html){.btn .btn-primary .mt-3}

## Our Services {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

::::: {.row .g-4 .stagger-children}
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Tower Cranes
Supply, erection, and dismantling of tower cranes with option of painted client colours. Includes floodlights, anti-climb guards, anti-collision systems, aircraft warning lights, and anemometers.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Mobile Cranes
Contract and mobile lifting services for projects requiring flexible crane solutions. Rapid deployment with experienced operators.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Spider Cranes & Forklifts
Compact lifting solutions for confined spaces, internal works, and specialist applications where tower cranes cannot reach.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Lifting Management
General management of all lifting operations on site. Ongoing adaptation of lifting plans and labour needs to match project progress.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Lifting Supervisors
Experienced supervisors overseeing all lifting activities, ensuring compliance with regulations and maintaining safety standards across the site.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Slingers & Signallers
Competent operatives for all slinging and signalling operations. All personnel hold current CPCS/CSCS cards with regular refresher training.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Appointed Persons
Qualified Appointed Persons to plan and supervise all lifting operations, produce lift plans, and ensure compliance with LOLER regulations.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Lifting Accessories
Complete range: chains, slings, shackles, lifting beams, goods cages, brick cages, cantidecks, hardydecks, lifting skips, mortar bins, block grabs, man riders, and rescue cages.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Auditing & Certification
On-site certification and inspection of all equipment. Weekly lifting records, 6-monthly checks, and comprehensive auditing services.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### 24/7 Support
Round-the-clock support management. Spares kept on site including chains, radios, and slings to minimise downtime.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Crane Rescue Training
Specialist crane rescue kit, cages, and training for emergency situations. Ensuring your team is prepared for any eventuality.
:::
::::::
:::::: {.col-md-4 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}
::: {.service-card}
#### Hoist Operations
Experienced hoist operators and banksmen for passenger and materials hoists across all project types.
:::

## How We Work {.mb-2}

::: {.gold-line}
:::

::: {.mb-4}
Our management systems are designed to maximise safety, efficiency, and transparency across every project.
:::

::::: {.row .g-4}
:::::: {.col-md-6 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}

::: {.service-card}
#### Weekly Planning & Coordination

- **Weekly Planning Boards** to plan ahead and coordinate lifting activities
- **Weekly Crane Usage Charts** tracking utilisation and efficiency
- **Weekly Crane Meetings** with all stakeholders
- **Wind Boards** monitoring weather conditions and safe working limits
- **Weekly Lifting Records** for full compliance documentation
:::

::::::
:::::: {.col-md-6 .animate-on-scroll .fade-up}

::: {.service-card}
#### People Development & Safety

- **NVQ Progression** — refresher training and qualifications pathway
- **Monthly Assessments** on all workers
- **Shadow Man Programme** — operatives under one year shadow experienced colleagues until team-approved for independent work
- **Incentive Awards** — slinger/operator of the month for best practice
- **Safety Critical Medical** — yearly medicals for all operators
:::
